meta.title: Line totals without line tax on a charges template
gaps: The S2 stage and charges template cannot be created with the available setup recipes.
The available read-back fields do not expose line total, price, quantity, or line tax, so the exact calculation line total = price × quantity cannot be asserted.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer lists the event's line items.
As the buyer, list the event's line items and check that the read succeeds; the reply is not empty.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds; the reply is not empty.
